verdict.rationale: MotherDuck Flights is a managed service for scheduled Python ingest jobs: MotherDuck runs the runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging and versioning, so you don't host pipeline infrastructure. That gives recurring, schedule-based ingestion rather than ingestion triggered as files or events arrive, and you still write the job code yourself. missing for 10: event- or file-arrival-triggered continuous ingestion, streaming/event ingestion support, any managed ingestion connector that needs no user-written code, independent or hands-on corroboration of Flights.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, a managed service continuously ingests new files or events as they arrive, without me running my own pipeline infrastructure

citations.quote: Run Python jobs on a schedule for ingest, transformation, and operational tasks
Flights handle the infrastructure: Python runtime, scheduling, secrets, logging, and versioning.
Python jobs built by your favorite agent and deployed in MotherDuck. Ingest, enrich, and transform data without expensive ETL.
